# Phase 5A.4: Domain and O(3) Transport Audit

## Discrepancy variant definitions
- exact_transported: MP tensor rotated into JARVIS Cartesian frame using structure-match rotation.
- proper_orbit: minimum discrepancy over proper rotations in the common point group.
- domain_aware: minimum of signed and inversion-flipped discrepancy (polar-domain equivalent).
- point_group_equivalent: minimum discrepancy over the full common point group.
- symmetry_projected: discrepancy after Reynolds projection onto the common point group.
